title: Add long-runner skill: sequential multi-spec orchestrator
body:
## Context

Currently, `spec-to-pr` handles delivery of a single spec (or single issue converted to spec). When a project has a queue of specs (e.g. in `.agents/specs/` or an explicit list), developers must trigger `/spec-to-pr` manually for each spec after the prior PR merges.

We need a **`long-runner`** orchestrator skill that reads a queue of specs, dispatches a sequential `spec-to-pr` worker for each, handles probes (skip already-implemented items), manages a unified run state file, and pauses on failure with a clear recovery gate.

## Requirements

Create a new skill under `.agents/skills/long-runner/` with:

1. `SKILL.md` — Frontmatter (`name: long-runner`, `version: 0.0.1`, `description`), native tool contract, goals, invariants, trigger patterns (`/long-runner`).
2. `PROTOCOL.md` — Master loop protocol (6 phases: entry, scan/init, select next, dispatch worker, record outcome, advance/report), invariants, dependency matrix.
3. `STATE.md` — State schema (`{plansDir}/long-runner/lr-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ.state.md`), field rules, parseable `step-output` contract, already-implemented probe, blank-list scan, resume policy.
4. `EXAMPLES.md` — Usage examples for blank list, explicit spec list, resume, failure pause.
5. `evals/evals.json` — 3+ evaluation prompt test cases.
6. Register `long-runner` in `bin/skill-dependencies.json` under `workflows` package.
7. Update skill catalogs / indexes (`AGENTS.md`, `.agents/AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills/shared/AGENTS.md`).
8. Re-generate site (`node bin/build-site.js`) and integrity digests (`npm run generate-integrity`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- `check-harness` passes with 0 critical errors.
- `npm run verify-integrity` passes with exit code 0.
- `npm test` / `npm run tests -- --local` passes cleanly.
